mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals a weak labor market, which typically precedes economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) and low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5) indicate an unaddressed inflationary threat, causing market anxiety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, strong housing starts (HOUST > 660) and robust retail sales (RSAFS > 410000) signal sustained consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when HOUST > 660 and RSAFS > 410000 during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 95 indicates robust manufacturing activity, which typically supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when INDPRO > 95 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing market activity (HOUST < 650) signals declining consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 650.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) typically triggers expectations of monetary tightening, causing equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230.

mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production (INDPRO > 95) reflects strong manufacturing output, which supports economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when INDPRO > 95 over any 3-year rolling window.
